This Statement has been prepared in accordance with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015(as ammended), prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 and other recognised accounting practices and policies to the extent possible.

The above unaudited Financial Results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on October 27, 2026. The Statutory Auditors of the Company have carried out a Limited Review of the above results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015.

As at September 30, 2026, the Company does not have any subsidiary(ies) or associate(s) and has one joint venture company.
The Company has disclosed its share of Profit/Loss in the Consolidated Financial Statements accompanying the standalone financial statements.

The Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on July 24, 2026, had recommended a final dividend of Rs.0.50 per equity share of face value Rs.5 each (i.e., 10% of the face value) for the financial year 2025–26. The said dividend was approved by the shareholders at the Annual General Meeting held on August 26, 2026, and was paid in September 2026.

The above is an extract of the detailed format for quarter ended financial results filed with the stock exchange under Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The full format of Financial results are available on stock exchanges websites (www.bseindia.com and www.nseindia.com).

Figures for the previous year/half year/quarter have been regrouped/rearranged, wherever necessary to confirm to those of current quarter classification.
